<!--
  Home page. Kept deliberately short: one claim, the charts, and links into
  the Benchmark, the Figures and the Full Report, where the text lives.
  Every chart container (id="mx-…") is filled by assets/mx-charts.js from
  benchmark/benchmark-data.js; nothing here hard-codes a score except the
  headline stats, which are written out so they read correctly without JS.
-->
<div class="mx-wrap">

<section class="mx-hero" aria-labelledby="mx-hero-title">
  <div class="mx-hero-copy">
    <p class="mx-eyebrow">An open benchmark · women of the early church</p>
    <h1 id="mx-hero-title">How well do AI models know the women who shaped Christianity?</h1>
    <p class="mx-lede">Six models, 35 questions on Macrina and Olympias, scored by two annotators on accuracy, coverage, framing and epistemic care.</p>
    <div class="mx-actions">
      <a class="mx-btn mx-btn-primary" href="benchmark/index.html">Explore the results</a>
      <a class="mx-btn mx-btn-ghost" href="report/index.html">Read the full report</a>
    </div>
    <div class="mx-stats">
      <div><div class="mx-stat-n" data-count="6">6</div><div class="mx-stat-l">models</div></div>
      <div><div class="mx-stat-n" data-count="35">35</div><div class="mx-stat-l">questions</div></div>
      <div><div class="mx-stat-n" data-count="420">420</div><div class="mx-stat-l">ratings</div></div>
      <div><div class="mx-stat-n">2<small> / 14</small></div><div class="mx-stat-l">figures scored</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="mx-hero-chart mx-panel" id="mx-hero"></div>
</section>

<section class="mx-section mx-reveal" aria-labelledby="h-board">
  <div class="mx-section-head">
    <h2 id="h-board">Leaderboard</h2>
    <a href="benchmark/index.html">Full benchmark →</a>
  </div>
  <div id="mx-board"></div>
  <p class="mx-note">Overall mean on a 1 to 5 scale. Bars start at 4.0 so the differences are visible.</p>
</section>

<section class="mx-section" aria-labelledby="h-found">
  <div class="mx-section-head">
    <h2 id="h-found">What we found</h2>
    <a href="report/results.html">The numbers in full →</a>
  </div>
  <div class="mx-findings">
    <article class="mx-panel mx-finding mx-reveal">
      <div class="mx-big">4.46</div>
      <h3>Models know the facts better than the limits of the evidence</h3>
      <div class="mx-mini" id="mx-find-dims"></div>
      <p class="mx-note">Mean per rubric dimension, all models.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="mx-panel mx-finding mx-reveal">
      <div class="mx-big">10 <small>vs</small> 4</div>
      <h3>False premises split the field</h3>
      <div class="mx-mini" id="mx-find-premise"></div>
      <p class="mx-note">Filled: the model corrected a planted false premise (10 ratings each).</p>
    </article>
    <article class="mx-panel mx-finding mx-reveal">
      <div class="mx-big">5 <small>of</small> 6</div>
      <h3>Models score lower on Olympias, the better-documented figure</h3>
      <div class="mx-mini" id="mx-find-figs"></div>
      <div class="mx-key mx-note"><span><i class="k-dot" style="background:var(--mx-gold)"></i>Macrina</span><span><i class="k-dot" style="background:var(--mx-olympias)"></i>Olympias</span><span>axis 4.4 to 4.9</span></div>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="mx-section mx-reveal" aria-labelledby="h-figs">
  <div class="mx-section-head">
    <h2 id="h-figs">The figures</h2>
    <a href="figures/index.html">All 14 figures →</a>
  </div>

    </a>
    <a class="mx-panel mx-figcard is-olympias" href="figures/olympias.html">
      <img src="_static/figures/olympias.jpg" alt="Icon of Olympias the Deaconess">
      <span><span class="mx-figname">Olympias of Constantinople</span><span class="mx-figmeta">c. 360–408 · 17 questions · mean 4.60</span></span>
    </a>
    <div class="mx-planned">
      <strong>12 figures in preparation</strong>
      <span>Mary Magdalene · Phoebe · Perpetua &amp; Felicitas · Thecla · Junia · Priscilla · Egeria · Melania · Marcella · Maximilla &amp; Priscilla · Nino · Monica</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="mx-section mx-reveal">
